ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Life and Art of Jacob Lawrence

fullPassage: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter known for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily life. Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he moved to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center. He used bright colors and simplified shapes in his paintings. The Migration Series, widely regarded as Jacob Lawrence's masterpiece, brought him national recognition. During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many paintings, but most of them were lost. Later, he taught at the University of Washington for 16 years. Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. Until a few weeks before his death, he continued to explore the lives of African-Americans through his painting.

questions.passage: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter (A)[known / unknown] for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily life. Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he moved to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center. He used (B)[bright / dull] colors and simplified shapes in his paintings. The Migration Series, widely regarded as Jacob Lawrence's masterpiece, brought him (C)[national / local] recognition. During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many paintings, but most of them were lost. Later, he taught at the University of Washington for 16 years. Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. Until a few weeks before his death, he continued to explore the lives of African-Americans through his painting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① known — bright — national: 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② unknown(알려지지 않은)은 '~로 알려진 화가'와 반대
❌ ③ dull(칙칙한)은 bright(밝은) 색을 썼다는 것과 반대
❌ ④ unknown + dull + local 모두 원문과 불일치
det.tip: known(알려진) ↔ unknown / bright(밝은) ↔ dull(칙칙한) / national(전국적인) ↔ local(지역의)

questions.passage: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter known for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily life. Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he (A)[moved / stayed] to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center. He used bright colors and simplified shapes in his paintings. During World War II, he (B)[served / avoided] in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many paintings, but most of them were lost. Later, he (C)[taught / studied] at the University of Washington for 16 years. Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① stayed(머물렀다)는 할렘으로 '옮겨갔다'는 맥락과 반대
✅ ② moved — served — taught: 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ avoided(피했다)는 해안경비대에 '복무했다'와 반대
❌ ④ stayed + avoided + studied 모두 원문과 불일치
det.tip: moved(옮기다) ↔ stayed(머물다) / served(복무하다) ↔ avoided(피하다) / taught(가르치다) ↔ studied(공부하다)

questions.passage: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter known for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily life. Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he moved to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center. He used bright colors and simplified shapes in his paintings. The Migration Series, widely regarded as Jacob Lawrence's masterpiece, brought him national recognition. During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and (A)[produced / destroyed] many paintings, but most of them were lost. Later, he taught at the University of Washington for 16 years. Throughout his lifetime, he (B)[received / refused] honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① destroyed(파괴했다)는 그림을 '제작했다'는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② refused(거부했다)는 명예 학위를 '받았다'와 반대
✅ ③ produced — received — continued: 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ destroyed + refused는 원문과 불일치
det.tip: produced(제작하다) ↔ destroyed(파괴하다) / received(받다) ↔ refused(거부하다) / continued(계속하다) ↔ stopped(멈추다)

Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he moved to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center. He used bright colors and ②<u>simplified</u> shapes in his paintings. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ saved(구해진) → lost(분실된). 많은 그림이 대부분 '분실되었다'
det.analysis:
❌ ① vivid — 원문. '생생한' 장면
❌ ② simplified — 원문. '단순화된' 형태
❌ ③ national — 원문. '전국적인' 인정
✅ ④ saved — 원문은 lost. 2차 대전 중 많은 그림을 제작했지만 대부분 '분실되었다(lost)'가 흐름에 맞아요. 'but(그러나)' 뒤라 부정적 결과가 와야 하므로 '구해졌다(saved)'는 모순 ←정답
det.tip: but 뒤 부정적 결과 → lost(분실된). saved(구해진)는 반대

Throughout his lifetime, he ④<u>received</u> honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① known — 원문. '~로 알려진' 화가
✅ ② dull — 원문은 bright. 그는 '생생한 장면(vivid scenes)'으로 유명했고 '밝은 색(bright colors)'을 썼다고 해야 자연스러워요. '칙칙한(dull)'은 반대 ←정답
❌ ③ masterpiece — 원문. 그의 '걸작'
❌ ④ received — 원문. 명예 학위를 '받았다'
det.tip: vivid(생생한) 장면의 화가 → bright(밝은) 색. dull(칙칙한)은 반대

det.analysis:
❌ ① regarded — 원문. 걸작으로 '여겨지는'
❌ ② served — 원문. 해안경비대에 '복무했다'
✅ ③ studied — 원문은 taught. 그는 명예 학위를 받은 화가로서 워싱턴 대학교에서 16년간 '가르쳤다(taught)'가 맞아요. '공부했다(studied)'는 학생이라는 뜻이라 모순 ←정답

det.tip: 16년간 재직 → taught(가르쳤다). studied(공부했다)는 학생을 뜻해 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그의 걸작이 그에게 가져다준 것 → 전국적인 '인정'(recognition)
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞은 'The Migration Series ... brought him national __________(그에게 전국적인 ~을 가져다주었다)'예요. 걸작이 가져다준 것은 긍정적인 '인정·명성'이에요.

✅ ① recognition(인정): 걸작이 가져다준 명성과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② punishment(처벌): 걸작의 결과로 맞지 않아요
❌ ③ criticism(비판): 부정적이라 '걸작'과 어울리지 않아요
❌ ④ silence(침묵): 명성을 얻은 맥락과 반대예요
det.tip: brought him national recognition = 전국적 인정을 가져다주다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a work of art or literature that is considered the finest or greatest that an artist has created"

det.tip: masterpiece = 걸작. master(대가) + piece(작품)

questions.passage: During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many __________ (paint), but most of them were lost.

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞은 'produced many __________(많은 ~을 제작했다)'예요. many 뒤에는 셀 수 있는 복수명사가 와야 해요. 동사 paint(그리다)를 '그림'을 뜻하는 명사로 바꾸고, many라서 복수형 paintings(그림들)로 써요.
det.tip: paint(동사) → painting(명사, 그림). many 뒤라 복수형 paintings

questions.passage: Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. Until a few weeks before his __________ (die), he continued to explore the lives of African-Americans.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞은 'a few weeks before his __________(그의 ~ 몇 주 전까지)'예요. 소유격 his 뒤에는 명사가 필요해요. 동사 die(죽다)를 명사 death(죽음)로 바꿔요. 'before his death(그가 죽기 전)'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: die(동사) → death(명사, 죽음). 소유격 his 뒤라 명사형

questions.passage: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter known for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily life. Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he moved to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center. He used bright colors and simplified shapes in his paintings. The Migration Series, widely regarded as Jacob Lawrence's masterpiece, brought him national recognition. During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many paintings, but most of them were lost. Later, he taught at the University of Washington for 16 years. Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. Until a few weeks before his death, he continued to explore __________ through his painting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그가 그림으로 평생 탐구한 대상 → '아프리카계 미국인의 삶'
det.analysis:
이 글은 그가 '아프리카계 미국인의 역사와 일상(African-American history and daily life)'을 그린 화가라고 시작해요. 마지막까지 그림으로 탐구한 대상도 같은 주제예요.

❌ ① the rules of modern architecture(현대 건축의 규칙): 화가의 주제와 무관해요
✅ ② the lives of African-Americans(아프리카계 미국인의 삶): 글 전체 주제와 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ the history of ancient Rome(고대 로마의 역사): 문맥과 관계없어요
❌ ④ the future of space travel(우주여행의 미래): 전혀 맞지 않아요
det.tip: 글 첫 문장의 African-American 주제 → 마지막까지 '아프리카계 미국인의 삶'을 탐구

questions.passage: Jacob Lawrence was an American painter known for vivid scenes of African-American history and daily life. Born in Atlantic City in 1917, he moved to Harlem at 13 and studied art at Utopia Children's Center. He used bright colors and simplified shapes in his paintings. The Migration Series, widely regarded as Jacob Lawrence's masterpiece, brought him national recognition. During World War II, he served in the U.S. Coast Guard and produced many paintings, but most of them were lost. Later, he taught __________. Throughout his lifetime, he received honorary degrees from several universities, including Harvard. Until a few weeks before his death, he continued to explore the lives of African-Americans through his painting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 앞은 'Later, he taught __________(나중에 그는 ~에서 가르쳤다)'이고, 바로 뒤 문장에서 '여러 대학에서 명예 학위를 받았다'고 해요. 그는 대학에서 가르친 교육자예요.

❌ ① in a small art gallery in Harlem(할렘의 작은 미술관에서): 가르친 장소로 언급되지 않아요
❌ ② during his service in the Coast Guard(해안경비대 복무 중에): 그때는 그림을 제작했어요
❌ ③ for a popular fashion magazine(인기 패션 잡지에서): 문맥과 무관해요
✅ ④ at the University of Washington for 16 years(워싱턴 대학교에서 16년간): 대학에서 가르친 경력과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: he taught(가르쳤다) + 명예 학위 → 대학에서 16년간 재직
